name: architecture
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium ecommerce intelligence agency service-card artwork, transparent cutout, square composition.
Primary request: An expressive impossible architectural sculpture: three dark olive monolithic folded slabs at different levels, joined by one sinuous translucent acid-lime glass ribbon that threads through their carved apertures; small brushed-chrome joint details. Suggest a connected commerce operating foundation, with strong asymmetry and elegant negative space. Not a stack of generic boxes, not a building or storefront.
Style: high-end contemporary digital sculpture / tactile fine-art still-life, photoreal rendered materials, editorial art direction. Dramatic but restrained, premium independent design studio. Strong filled sculptural masses, precise realistic edges, subtle surface grain, no cartoon drawing.
Palette: near-black #080d0b, deep olive #203018, acid lime #cbff65, restrained brushed silver/chrome highlights. No pastel backdrops or other bright colors.
Composition: single coherent sculptural assembly centered, fills 70–78% of square canvas, all edges fully visible, generous transparent margin around entire silhouette. Three-quarter macro studio view with realistic depth, floating slightly, tightly composed.
Lighting: sculpted soft key light and acid-lime rim light, luminous glass, rich dark surfaces still legible against near-black website. Natural subtle occlusion and reflections, no excessive bloom.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha; no colored rectangle, no vignette, no ground plane.
Constraints: no typography, logos, UI, watermark, storefront, cartoon clipart, tiny outline symbols, decorative stars, infographic arrows or generic dashboard components. Make this feel like a commissioned contemporary artwork.
